description: The Microsoft community Windows Package Manager manifest repository
vibe: One package per PR, no blank issues, no scanning the whole manifests tree — keep it surgical.
highlights: Strict one-package-per-PR rule to keep changes reviewable and reversible.
Explicit ban on recursively scanning the entire manifests/ directory — work only in the target package folder.
Mandatory use of structured GitHub issue forms; blank issues are disallowed unless a maintainer asks.
Clear routing of WinGet client issues to microsoft/winget-cli, keeping this repo scoped to manifests.
Requires local validation via `winget validate --manifest <path>` or an explicit explanation for skipping it.
assessment: This file reflects mature maintainer discipline: it constrains scope (one package, one folder), enforces structured intake via issue forms, and demands evidence of validation. By explicitly forbidding whole-tree scans and speculative patches in issues, it protects both CI cost and reviewer attention — a pragmatic systems approach to governing a massive community-contributed manifest repository.
